title: Conquer Your Anger
coreMove: Anger can warn you that something matters, but it must not steer; pause, record the cue, and act only when judgment can protect trust and accountability.

exampleSpecs.audience: people who mistake public correction for a command to strike back
exampleSpecs.stakes: show anger as a signal that must not steer
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Mara feels public correction start an anger chain and pauses before replying

exampleSpecs.audience: people repairing trust after anger damages a real issue
exampleSpecs.stakes: separate the operational problem from the outburst
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Nia owns her tone and still brings the parts timeline back into view

exampleSpecs.audience: people who need a body reset before a firm correction
exampleSpecs.stakes: keep command before the next sentence
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Sol restarts the officiating routine before correcting a parent

exampleSpecs.audience: people who need to repair small trust after a sharp exchange
exampleSpecs.stakes: show the cost of heat in a delicate family fact
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Inez finds the plain fact she had demanded after her voice had already done harm

exampleSpecs.audience: people learning anger's social cost after facts arrive late
exampleSpecs.stakes: let evidence expose heat that made the group choose sides
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Leila sees that volume arrived before evidence

exampleSpecs.stakes: interrupt the destructive passion before it becomes a full posture
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Maren catches herself blaming a student and restarts the review
